item.title: Vixen Studio 3.13.4 alpha 5
item.description:
Changes

  • Backlog B66: derive the host test's apiVersion from API_VERSION (182f7e11b)
  • Backlog B64: drop the diagonal nudge for Single bulbs (4b0fe8b09)
  • Backlog B62: single bulbs from a plugin controller's lights (Govee devices) (67fbd9867)
  • Backlog B61: plugin controllers set their own output count; settings actions (Detect Lights) (f8bac26e0)
  • Backlog B63: keep Single lights drawn on the x = y diagonal when the preview opens (402403888)
  • Backlog B60: single bulbs in one step (smart bulbs, lamps, ceiling lights) (7888d8a2d)
